column1: # Pages the crop method once got wrong, or the owner pointed at (2026-10-08). Every change to scripts/book_crop.py is
# checked against all of them (scripts/crop_regress.py) before a sample is shown. Columns: phone path, page (1-based),
# check, expected, note. Checks: cropped = the page is cropped, not left whole (yes/no); turn = the page is levelled (expected: yes/no); out = a mark region (x0,y0,x1,y1 in pt) must
# lie outside the box; in = a region that must lie inside what the reader sees (the box, or the part shrunk to it); centred = the
# page's content centred in its box (±2 %); xcentre = the shown part's centre at X±T pt (a measured anchor: page number, heading);
# ycentre = the shown part's middle at Y±T pt (a page placed where its neighbours are: its page number where theirs is);
# parity = the book's odd/even pages get different horizontal places (yes/no).
# level = the page as the reader sees it, turned or not, reads level by its lines' baselines: |angle| ≤ the expected degrees
# (book_crop.base_angles at 1,400 px: their median, lines more than 1° from it — two lines run together — left out, at least
# 6 lines within an IQR of 0.3° — a turn too far fails it as surely as one left undone; 2026-10-27).
